ASCON.source: ASCON v1.2 specification, 5-bit S-box table (NIST LWC standard)

DAC.source: original DAC S-box, paper Table 3 (Sarmila & Manisekaran, EIJ 2025)

DAC-OPT.source: affine equivalent of x^-1 over GF(2^5): DU 2, NL 10, degree 4, SAC 0.5

DAC-OPT-GOLD.source: affine equivalent of x^3 over GF(2^5): DU 2, NL 12, degree 2, SAC 0.5

E-DAC.source: table printed in paper.tex (tab:edac_sbox); legacy unseeded annealing, not reproducible; true NL(S) = 8

Keccak-chi.source: Keccak chi on one 5-bit row, computed from b_i = a_i ^ (~a_{i+1} & a_{i+2})
